newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. 260 MW coal-fired unit up after short outage.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. 260 MW coal-fired unit up after short outage.

text.p: The 260 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the Cholla coal-fired power plant at Joseph City, Ariz., was restarted Monday afternoon after a two-hour outage, a spokesman for Arizona Public Service Co said.
The unit was shut to repair a "slightly leaking hydraulic valve," he said. It had reached 61 MW as of 1430 PST (1730 EST).
Cholla's other units, 1 at 110 MW, 2 at 245 MW and 4 at 380 MW, were said to be operating normally.
Arizona Power operates the Cholla plant and owns units 1, 2 and 3. Unit 4 is owned by PacifiCorp.
